script: Over a few months, these notes will show you patterns. You may see that your best work comes in the morning, or that one type of client pays better. Use those patterns to plan. Do not treat one bad week as proof that the course is wrong. Most growth is slow, and it shows only when you look back over several weeks. Build a small network. Join one or two professional groups, and answer questions honestly. Share something useful each week, such as a tip or a lesson you learned. Finally, write down one income goal and one time goal for each quarter, which is every three months. Review them, adjust, and continue. In the last video, we build your ninety-day action plan.
